title: Trace a proposal through schema and policy
description: Choose a contract and an incoming call. The same arguments can pass JSON Schema yet still fail authorization.

contracts.label: Loose object
contracts.detail: Only checks that arguments are an object; optional fields and extras pass.

contracts.label: Bounded schema
contracts.detail: Requires the two known fields, validates their types, closes the enum, and rejects extras.

calls.label: Valid order lookup
calls.detail: The caller requests an allowed view of an order in its own tenant.

calls.label: Model adds an admin flag
calls.detail: An unknown model-supplied field tries to widen the underlying operation.

calls.label: Unsupported data view
calls.detail: The requested view is a string, but it is outside the contract's closed enum.

calls.label: Cross-tenant identifier
calls.detail: The arguments are perfectly shaped, but the resource belongs to another tenant.

calls.label: Permission was revoked
calls.detail: The arguments and tenant match, but the caller no longer has orders:read.
